patch.value: web status/stop/doctor shadow the host-owned --json global and fail to register on pm-cli 2026.7.27

pm-cli 2026.7.27 (GH-719) makes the host reject any extension command whose flags shadow a host-owned global flag. The pm-web commands web status, web stop, and web doctor each declared { long: "--json" } in their flags array, so all three failed to register against a real pm host:

  registerCommand definition metadata invalid: registerFlags cannot shadow host-owned global flag "--json"

The existing smoke.test.ts could not catch this because it built a hand-rolled api double (extension.activate(api as any)) that accepted every registration unconditionally — green CI, broken extension.

Fix: removed the --json flag declaration from all three commands and read the value from ctx.global.json === true instead (the host owns --json globally). Rewrote smoke.test.ts on createExtensionTestHarness so it runs pm's real validation engine, and added a suite-wide guard asserting no registered command redeclares any of the nine host-owned globals. Bumped @unbrained/pm-cli to 2026.7.27 and package/manifest version to 2026.7.27.
